name: FSP Technology Inc
summary: FSP Technology Inc. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of power supply solutions and various electronic components, operating both in Taiwan and worldwide. Their diverse product portfolio encompasses a wide array of power-related items such as AC adapters, open frame power supplies, industrial PC power units (PSUs), battery charging devices, and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS). Additionally, they offer specialized medical-grade PSUs, comprehensive energy storage systems, drivers for SSL LEDs, and power units designed for displays. These offerings find application across numerous sectors, including healthcare (for medical equipment power), gaming consoles, power delivery (PD) chargers, smart manufacturing facilities, 5G infrastructure, smart home technologies, as standalone battery chargers, and within UPS and energy storage systems (ESS). Established in 1993, the company maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan, Taiwan.
